title: Independent computational test of sulfonyl-directed cycloaddition selectivity
difficulty_reasons: Requires locating and validating competing open-shell/spin-state transition states and comparable free-energy references rather than a fixed single calculation.
Conformer and transition-state search coverage must be justified for two competing channels.
